doc: One village building to build: what the game asks for ("the smithy of a family, deluxe, in winter, on its other footprint"), plus the seed that makes it differ from its neighbours and the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: palette
fields.doc: The colour scheme mixed over the type's colours (natural keeps them).

fields.name: theme
fields.doc: The village theme: its architecture and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: How far its owner has come: construction (a tent on a staked plot), basic, deluxe, or premium. Every stage stands on the same footprint. A ruin is a premium house fallen to wreck: roofless, its walls broken, overgrown.

fields.name: household
fields.doc: Who lives or works there, which sets the lot's size: solo (one person; room to work and to lie down), family (a couple and their children), or extended (several generations under one roof, two storeys once it is deluxe).

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: The type's usual lot shape, or its other one.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Stable randomness: the runtime maps each building's ID onto a capped set of seeds per quality level.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from distance and quality.
